provider.notes: Legacy FPT.AI Speech on api.fpt.ai. 'general' is the engine segment of the vendor URL path (/hmi/asr/general); it resolves an empty model to the documented row instead of the provider default. Registry id and aliases: gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:1799-1800; the standardized factory that live sessions use accepts fpt-ai, fpt_ai, fptai and fpt (gateway/src/core/stt/standard.rs:423-425). The gateway's only client is a request-and-response HTTP client that buffers the whole call and uploads at hang-up, at a client commit (audio_end disconnects the client, which flushes: gateway/src/core/voice_manager/manager.rs:1648-1672, gateway/src/core/stt/fpt_ai/client.rs:345-349) or after 9.6 MB; it is not a transport. The server has no API-key mapping for this provider (gateway/src/config/mod.rs:679). FPT AI Marketplace (mkp-api.fptcloud.com, OpenAI-compatible) is a separate host this client does not reach; it listed no speech-to-text model on 2026-10-03 and has no row here. If a model is relisted there, serve it as an OpenAI-compatible deployment.

transports.disabled_reason: No file-upload adapter for live calls exists (not implemented). The only FPT client buffers the whole call and uploads at hang-up or after 9.6 MB (300 s at 16 kHz), so a call gets no transcript while it is in progress. Before enabling, a probe with a real key must confirm that the vendor accepts WAV at all.

gateway_client.code_ref: gateway/src/core/stt/fpt_ai/client.rs:89-190 (request and response code to extract); gateway/src/core/stt/fpt_ai/client.rs:372-407 (buffering); gateway/src/core/stt/fpt_ai/config.rs:23
gateway_client.notes: The request code to lift out is FptStt::process_audio, a private method tied to the session buffer: POST https://api.fpt.ai/hmi/asr/general, header api_key, the WAV file as the raw body with Content-Type audio/wav (client.rs:120-126); JSON reply with status 0 success, 1 no voice, 2 cancelled, 9 system busy, and hypotheses[].utterance. It has only been run against a mock the repository wrote (gateway/tests/mock_endpoint_e2e.rs:1006-1029), never against the vendor. Defects to fix when extracting: confidence is a constant 0.9 (client.rs:219); the stored error callback is never invoked and the hang-up upload error is discarded (client.rs:347-349); the vendor's status 9 is read after the HTTP status was already reported to the circuit breaker, so a busy vendor that answers HTTP 200 never trips it (client.rs:132-133 against :164-178); the vendor's reason text is dropped; the request timeout is 60 s (config.rs:26). The vendor's status 1 (no voice) is the only signal usable for dropping a segment; it is recorded as quality_signals no_speech_flag.

segment_profile.rationale: Provisional and inferred, not a vendor fact. The 25 s default exists for Whisper's 30 s window, which does not apply here; the vendor documents no maximum and describes the engine as built for basic command sentences, and a synchronous decode takes longer as audio gets longer. Split at the last pause before 15 s and raise it only after a probe with a real key shows longer segments are accepted and accurate. Uploads in flight stay at the default of two; drop to one for the session after any status 9 (system busy), the vendor's only back-pressure signal. The 8 s request timeout is the audit's conversational budget, not a measurement: the vendor publishes no response time, and the client's own 60 s (config.rs:26) is useless for a turn. Replace it with the measured 99th percentile plus a margin after the first probe with a real key.

when_unusable.code_ref: gateway/src/core/stt/fpt_ai/client.rs:372-407 (send_audio only buffers; the upload happens at hang-up, at a client commit or after 9.6 MB)

refusal.text: FPT.AI speech-to-text transcribes uploaded files only; the vendor offers no streaming interface. This gateway does not yet split a live call into utterances for it, so for a voice agent that decides when the caller has finished speaking no transcript would arrive until the call ends. Use a streaming transcription model, set the agent's turn detection to manual, or ask the operator to enable segmented speech-to-text for this deployment.

billing.notes: Prepaid packages of minutes priced in Vietnamese dong (2,000, 5,000 or 10,000 minutes; 60 trial minutes a year). How a short request is rounded against the minute quota is not documented. No entry for this provider exists in gateway/src/config/pricing.rs (checked 2026-10-03), so no pricing_key is given.

provenance.notes: The vendor API has no model parameter. 'general' is the engine segment of the vendor URL path /hmi/asr/general, fixed in the gateway (config.rs:23); it identifies the product in this map and is never sent as a parameter. The vendor documents one interface, a synchronous file POST, and no streaming interface, so segmentation is the only way to use this provider on a call. There is no language, prompt or format parameter, and the reply has no confidence, timestamps or language. An unauthenticated probe confirmed the endpoint is live (HTTP 401); nothing was transcribed. Reuse one HTTP/2 connection, which saved about 0.35 to 0.6 s per request in the probe. The WebSocket uplink decodes Opus to PCM16 before the client; mu-law frames would be wrapped as PCM16 and must be converted first.

provenance.notes: Provider default. The vendor has no model parameter and the client never reads the model string (config.rs:78-106), so any id reaches the same engine as the 'general' row; a session that supplies a model string should be told it is ignored. File upload is the only interface the vendor documents, so the default is file upload.
